name: Shift Change
hint: Two lifts, two riders each. Somebody has to work the late shift.
why4: Each lift needs two riders and gate A needs two on a plate, so one pair has to hold the gate while the other pair rides: a third player alone can neither ride nor hold.
solution: P4 and P3 walk right (one at a time over the left lift) and stand on the right lift at x=30-31 (2/2); it rises 10 tiles and waits at the top.

P2 and P1 stand on the left lift at x=9-10 (2/2); it rises to balcony Y. They jump onto the balcony together (a lift with one rider slides back down); P2 touches the key at x=16; both stand on the plate at x=13-14: gate A (x=32) opens.
P4 and P3 jump off the right lift together through gate A and stand on the inner plate at x=35-36.
P2 and P1 jump down off balcony Y, wait for the right lift to slide back down, ride it up and jump through gate A.
P2 hops over the others' heads and opens the door at x=42; all press Down.
